# Erdos.p1093 — Erdős problem 1093

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/1093
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/1093.lean`, theorem `erdos_1093.parts.ii`, AMS 5).

Are there only finitely many binomial coefficients with deficiency > 1?

## Statement
{x : ℕ × ℕ | let k := x.1; let n := x.2; 2 * k ≤ n ∧ deficiency n k > 1 ∧
      ∀ p, p.Prime → (p ∣ choose n k) → k < p}.Finite

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
